scope: Helper revision only; revision-v2, candidate U and installed runtime were not modified.

changes.result: render(spec_path, output_dir, name) captures the resolved workspace once per call and passes it through relative-path resolution, input/output containment, input-relative manifest paths and explicit project-font permission checks. No mutable workspace global remains.

Requested-character nonzero-glyph coverage must agree across all eligible supported Unicode format-4/12 cmap subtables. Uniform absence remains a missing-glyph error; disagreement is a clear unsupported-font error. This does not identify FreeType's active cmap.

Explicit fonts without OS/2 are supported. Numeric weight/stretch metadata remains null; actual head.macStyle flags provide nominal SVG weight/style with per-attribute provenance. Unavailable numeric SVG attributes are omitted. Existing OS/2 validation, explicit font bytes/index, copy conservation and painted bounds are retained.
Documented per-render workspace capture, conservative requested-character coverage, active-cmap uncertainty, absent-OS/2 metadata/provenance, and the two explicit installed-font fixtures.

preserved: Public render(spec_path, output_dir, name) API and exclusive SVG/PNG/manifest outputs
Current task workspace containment, including ordinary resolved symlink boundaries
Only explicit system/project fonts; no discovery, installation, downloading, font copies or silent substitution
No bitmap inputs, existing-poster edits or image_gen calls
Exact copy, fixed-newline handling, geometry and painted-canvas containment

verification.initial_run: 27 tests successful with one absent-serif-path skip; changed that same explicit font fixture from the absent direct Fonts path to the existing Supplemental path, then reran the full suite successfully with zero skips.
new_regressions: Imported API followed by chdir: relative paths, manifest input paths, old input/output rejection and a later independent workspace
One workspace snapshot remains valid when cwd changes during a render call
Explicit current-workspace font path reaches parsing; old-workspace path is rejected, using temporary marker bytes without copying a font

Synthetic supported format-4/12 cmaps: both disagreement directions, single-map controls, uniformly absent/present controls, different nonzero glyph IDs and conservative supplementary-character rejection

Actual /System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/AppleMyungjo.ttf successful Korean text render without OS/2: null numeric metadata, head flags/provenance, SVG omission, exact font hash/index/copy and measured advance; missing glyph, clipping and invalid face index still reject
Synthetic nominal head flag combinations and malformed-present-style-table rejection
verification.read_only_reviews: Separate cmap/workspace and font-metadata reviewers found no concrete residual issues. Neither reviewer wrote files or reran tests.
verification.test_artifacts: Only new disposable planning diagrams and temporary fixtures inside revision-v3; the suite cleaned them up. Python used -B.

limitations: Conservative supported-cmap agreement can reject a usable font, including supplementary coverage present only in format 12 beside a BMP format-4 cmap.
The helper does not identify FreeType's active cmap or prove shaping, glyph appearance, complex-script correctness or font application in a later image_gen result.
head.macStyle supplies nominal SVG style only; absent numeric OS/2 weight/width remains unknown. SVG viewers may substitute fonts and cannot be bound to supplied bytes or a TTC face index.
Ordinary filesystem containment/exclusivity is retained; it is not hardened against concurrent parent-directory replacement. Interrupted processes can leave partial outputs.
Validation was on this macOS runtime and the two explicit available fonts; no cross-platform execution, poster quality, design performance or final approval is claimed.
Audit finding 2 (candidate executable bundle wiring) is intentionally left to the root task; this worker performed no integration.
